text:
emily (Marketing): quick heads-up — pulling together launch-post learnings into the weekly KPI board. want to make sure inbound routing and webinar signups show up cleanly for tomorrow's review

sam (Growth): love it. can we surface delta vs baseline (pre-launch) and bounce by utm source?

jaz (Content): i can add a short narrative card for the launch posts — highlights + surprising picks. will drop a draft link in a sec :link: 

raj (Analytics): @emily @sam i'll wire up two widgets: 1) `inbound leads by routing rule` (live) and 2) `signup funnel — launch cohort` (cohorted by utm_campaign). SQL snippet i’ll use:
```
select source, count(*) as leads, sum(converted) as signups
from inbound_events
where event_ts >= '2026-02-01'
group by source
```

emily (Marketing): perfect. can we also flag any leads that took the `legacy-route`? that's been noisy lately.

raj (Analytics): yep — adding a small conditional metric: `legacy_pct = legacy_leads / total_leads`. will add alert if > 12%

taylor (Ops): FYI deploy bot shows routing policy rollout last night succeeded on prod — 3:12am. no errors in the logs. cc @raj in case the schema shifted.

leads-bot: new lead volume spike detected: +42% (last 24h) — source=launch_posts, top utm=(launch_q1)

sam (Growth): nice. would be good to annotate the spike on the dashboard timeline and call out top referrers. also planning a quick A/B on the CTAs for the next batch — want that to feed into the next KPI check.

jaz (Content): draft narrative here: https://docs.redwood.ai/marketing/launch-Q1-draft — covers messaging iterations + webinar CTA flows. feedback welcome.

emily (Marketing): thanks all. two asks before tomorrow: 1) @raj — add the legacy_pct alert and an annotation for the leads-bot spike 2) @jaz — shorten the narrative to a 90-word exec blurb for the dashboard card. i'll stitch into the weekly deck.

raj (Analytics): on it. ETA 45m. i'll post the new widget screenshots when done.

jaz (Content): will do a 90-word blurb now. sending in 20.

sam (Growth): if we see the legacy_pct pop, we should reroute new signups to the `safety` path while we triage — taylor can you confirm rollback steps?

taylor (Ops): confirmed — we have a quick rollback toggle in the router console. i can stand by if the alert fires.

emily (Marketing): awesome. if nobody objects i'll finalize dashboard copy at 10:45am and lock the deck for the KPI review. :thumbsup:
thread_summary: Coordinate moving launch-post insights into KPI dashboard: analytics to add widgets and alerts (legacy routing %, spike annotation), content to craft exec blurb, ops ready to rollback routing if alert triggers. prep for tomorrow's weekly KPI review.
